message: The other day, as the sky turned an ominous shade of gray, my kids were busy planning their ultimate indoor campout, complete with pillow forts and snack stations. Meanwhile, I was trying to remember where I stashed the flashlights and extra batteries. It’s funny how their idea of a storm is all fun and games, while mine is more about being ready for anything. I guess it’s all about finding that balance—while they build their fort, I’ll just be over here reinforcing the roof. How do you juggle the fun with the prep?
